info.title: AI Service Marketplace HTTP API
info.description: Source-aligned contract for the currently implemented public HTTP surface. This is a progressively formalized subset of the complete M1–M14 platform contract. Test-only endpoints are intentionally excluded. Response DTOs are being progressively formalized; where marked generic, the current handler and integration tests remain the compatibility reference.

delete.description: Revokes an active property delegation. Owners/admins may revoke either role; organization managers may revoke viewer delegations only.

200.description: Revokes an active property delegation. Owners/admins may revoke either role; organization managers may revoke viewer delegations only.

post.description: Only the owning customer may approve work after the professional marks the order completed. The immutable one-per-order approval makes retries idempotent. This operation does not capture, release or transfer funds.

200.description: The existing approval was returned for an idempotent retry.

post.description: Creates a new order from the original service, service-area and questionnaire-answer snapshot. The new schedule is required. Current provider availability is checked before creation; current active catalog, price and published questionnaire are revalidated by the normal order-creation transaction. Availability is a preflight, not a slot reservation; dispatch and booking revalidate it again. Idempotency is scoped to the source order and Idempotency-Key.

200.description: Existing order returned for an idempotent retry.

get.summary: Get a tenant-scoped production analytics summary

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive RFC3339 event-time upper bound; range must not exceed 90 days.

cookieAuth.name: marketplace_access
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly access cookie. Mutating browser requests must echo marketplace_csrf in X-CSRF-Token and satisfy same-origin validation.

refreshCookieAuth.name: marketplace_refresh
refreshCookieAuth.description: HttpOnly refresh cookie used only by the session refresh endpoint.

scheduled_at.description: Must be at least 30 minutes and no more than 90 days in the future.

answers.description: Required when a published questionnaire exists for the selected service, market and default locale. Validated against that immutable schema version and stored as an order snapshot.

to.description: Target state; the server validates the role-specific state machine.

label.description: User-visible device label; do not include secrets or sensitive personal data.

schema.description: Supported bounded JSON Schema subset; unsupported keywords are rejected.

data_ready.description: True only when production-classified market-attributed facts exist in the requested window and the active generation has no pending canonical tenant events.

excluded_events.description: Events excluded because traffic classification is not production or market attribution is missing.

pending_events.description: Canonical tenant-scoped outbox events not yet processed by the active generation's consumer.

emergency_notice.description: States that incident intake is not monitored as an emergency service.

reason.description: Required audit reason. Self-grant is prohibited.
Required audit reason. Self-revocation is prohibited.

status.description: Required only when action=status; transitions must be sequential.

severity_hint.description: Required only when action=severity; advisory triage hint only.

assigned_reviewer_identity_id.description: Required only when action=assign; target must have an active same-tenant incident:review grant.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated actor is not authorized for this operation.

NotFound.description: The requested resource or route was not found.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current resource state or idempotency record.

Unprocessable.description: The request is syntactically valid but violates domain constraints.

RateLimited.description: OTP or another bounded operation is rate limited.

SessionTransport.name: X-Session-Transport
SessionTransport.description: When set to cookie, auth endpoints establish HttpOnly session cookies.

CSRFToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CSRFToken.description: Required for cookie-authenticated browser mutations; bearer clients do not need this header.

TenantID.name: X-Tenant-ID
TenantID.description: Selects tenant context for tenant-scoped B2B requests. The server verifies current identity and tenant membership; this header is not an authorization credential.
